description: Upload a local image, audio or video as base64 to your private file library for up to 30 days. If the new file exceeds the library’s space or file-count limit, the oldest uploads that unfinished plans no longer need are deleted first. Returns an upload asset ID and evicted_count without a GPU job. Use this ID in uploads for Video/Edit/Upscale/Voice, or as a Movie asset. Reuse idempotency_key on retries. Never put base64 or a local path in batch arguments.

acknowledge_privacy.description: Confirm the user has permission to process any personal data in the inputs.

acknowledge_rights.description: Confirm the user has the rights or permissions to use the source material.

base64.description: Source file bytes encoded as base64.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key for the intended operation. Reuse it on network retries.

mime_type.description: Media type of the uploaded file.

name: asset_upload
title: Upload file to private library
